In this world, every door you hold open gives you one second back. At midnight. Ines wants as many as possible.
She holds forty doors before nine.
She spends six minutes in a door standoff to earn two seconds.
By evening, she has fifteen minutes saved. Nine hundred doors. She makes a list. Learn the guitar. Call her sister. Write the first page of a novel.
At midnight, the world waits. Fifteen extra minutes, just for her. She sleeps through all fifteen.
Best fifteen minutes of my life.
